description: A site is flagged 'Moderate' if its Theil-Sen trend-equivalent change over the observed period is at least 0.5 of the empirical AE-SJ gap between SJ1 and SJ2.
A site is flagged 'Large' if its Theil-Sen trend-equivalent change over the observed period is at least 0.5 of the empirical AE-SJ gap between SJ3 and SJ4.
